Defaults to 1. */ opacity?: number; /** Draw mode override. By default it is 'transparent' whenever the effective * alpha (colour alpha × opacity) is below 1, else the layer's opaque mode. * Pair translucent representations with <Pass oit>. */ mode?: DrawMode }
